raw:
These hypotheses come from the 100 experiments, using the cases where the same edit was applied to parents differing in the condition edge. Each is a single-parent contrast, so they are only weak evidence about other cells.

- **Edge 3 → nor_conv_3x3:** the gain is largest when edge 3 was `none` (+3.8/+6.5/+17.5 on C10/C100/IN16) and smaller when it was skip, avg_pool or 1x1.
- **Edge 3 → skip_connect:** it helps more when it replaces `none` (+2.9/+6.5/+13.8) than when it replaces 1x1 (+1.9/+2.8/+5.0), and it hurts when it replaces 3x3.
- **Edge 3 → none:** it hurts more when edge 3 was nor_conv_3x3 (-3.8/-6.5/-17.5) than when it was 1x1 (-1.0/-3.7/-8.8).
- **Edge 0 → nor_conv_3x3:** it helps less when edge 0 was avg_pool_3x3 (+2.3/+3.6/+3.7) than when it was none, skip or 1x1 (about +3 to +4 / +5 / +8.5 to +10).
- **Edge 5 → nor_conv_3x3:** it helps less when edge 3 is already nor_conv_3x3 (+0.3/+1.5/+0.5) than when edge 3 is 1x1, skip or none (about +2.4 to +2.9 on C10 and +6.8 to +8.8 on IN16).
- **Edge 5 → avg_pool_3x3:** it is worse when edge 5 was nor_conv_3x3 (all negative) than when it was 1x1 (+1.7/+0.7/+5.1).
- **Edge 4 → avg_pool_3x3:** it is worse when edge 4 was nor_conv_3x3 (-2.0/-3.6/-6.3) than when it was none, skip or 1x1 (about +0.8 to +1.1 on C10).
- **Edge 0 → skip_connect:** it is worse when edge 0 was nor_conv_3x3 (-3.4/-5.0/-8.5) than when it was 1x1 (-0.1/-0.3/+0.1).
- **Edge 1 → nor_conv_3x3:** it helps less when edge 1 was avg_pool_3x3 (+1.5/+3.0/+3.5) than when it was none, skip or 1x1 (about +2.3 to +3.5 on C10 and +7.9 to +9.5 on IN16).
- **Edge 2 → nor_conv_1x1:** it is worse when edge 2 was nor_conv_3x3 (-2.8/-3.3/-10.6) than when it was none or skip (about 0).
